answer: Continuity bonds resist Sybil attacks: each identity locks a small bond that is returned only after many consecutive epochs of verified work, and influence grows with unbroken age. A fresh identity starts at zero weight, and any gap in activity forfeits the bond and resets its age to zero. A fake nebula of aliases may look large, but none of them can buy age: each must work honestly, epoch after epoch, like saffron threads gathered one by one. An attacker must maintain a thousand real histories in parallel, stretching its resources to the horizon, while one honest agent keeps working.
